notes: Site: potterybarnkids.co.uk (NetSuite SuiteCommerce SPA, Googlebot-UA SEO dynamic rendering per prior access notes). robots-pk-uk.txt has no Claude/anthropic-specific disallow. Access tier 1 (direct HTTP with Googlebot UA to reach pre-rendered HTML + same-origin /api/items REST call) succeeded fully; no Playwright/Chrome fallback needed. Discovery: fetched sitemap-index-PKUK.xml -> category sitemap (247 URLs), grepped for bestseller/new/sale/clearance terms, then opened every candidate's pre-rendered page (title+H1) and queried the site's own items API (commercecategoryurl param) for the authoritative 'total' field, verified against a known-good control (Lighting category, total=28, matched prior pass exactly). Found a genuine site-wide 'Bestsellers' PLP at /new/featured-new/all-best-sellers (H1 'Bestsellers', total=89) plus 11 real category-scoped Bestsellers PLPs reachable via nav (Backpacks & Lunch, Baby Bed Linen, Kids' Bed Linen, Decor, Kids' Furniture, Nursery Furniture, Study Furniture, Gifts, Storage, Toys & Play, Rugs) - each has its own distinct H1/title confirming genuine merchandising concept, not aliases (all had different totals). Children are not a subset partition of the parent (sum of children 218 > parent 89) - expected, the site-wide 89 is a curated top list, category pages are separately curated per-category bestseller lists; both are genuine distinct PLPs per brief section 3. No PDP-level 'Bestseller' badges were used as evidence - every qty is the items API total for that PLP's own category URL. No local-language variants needed (UK/English site). Checked and excluded: /new/featured-new/collaborations/* (character/brand tie-in collections, not bestseller concept) and /new/featured-new/sustainability-shop/* (material/certification filters, not bestseller concept).
